champion.tips: KALISTA TIPS AND TRICKS You can use your Ultimate R to engage or collapse on enemies who are caught out of position. On the topic of Ultimates R , don’t be afraid to save your Support. Don’t use your Rend E until you’re completely finished with the skirmish as you may miss out on extra Rend E stacks. Activate E as you finish the exchange. Make good use of your W by using it to scout vision in the river. Aim it as far as it will so it provides as much information as possible.
champion.builds: THE BEST KALISTA BUILDS, RUNES AND ITEMS FOR BOT IN EMERALD + Most Popular If you want to use the most popular Kalista Bot build, you should take Flash and Barrier as your Summoner Spells. For runes, you should pick Lethal Tempo as your keystone, followed by Triumph, Legend: Alacrity and Last Stand in the primary tree, as well as Sudden Impact and Treasure Hunter in the secondary tree. For rune shards, you want Attack Speed in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health in defense, though it depends on the matchup. Finally, for your items, you should build Blade of The Ruined King as your first item, followed by Berserker's Greaves and Guinsoo's Rageblade. For your last 3 items, you should build Terminus, Jak'Sho, The Protean and finish with Wit's End. For the skill order, you want to stick with E - Q - W. Right now, this build has 49.9% winrate over 12 577 matches played. Alternative If you're looking for alternatives, you can use Flash and Barrier as your Summoner Spells, with runes being Hail of Blades as your keystone, Sudden Impact, Grisly Mementos and Treasure Hunter in the primary tree, and Legend: Alacrity with Triumph in the secondary tree, as well as Attack Speed, Adaptive Force, and Health Scaling as your rune shards. The items that this build incorporates are Blade of The Ruined King as your first item, then Berserker's Greaves as a second item and Guinsoo's Rageblade as a third item. You want to finish the build with Terminus, Jak'Sho, The Protean and Guardian Angel. As far as ability max order goes, you want to keep it E - Q - W. This build is currently sitting at a 48.9% win rate across 221 matches played. Off-Meta If you want to try an Off-Meta Kalista Bot build in the current patch, try Flash and Barrier as your Summoner Spells, Press the Attack, Triumph, Legend: Alacrity and Last Stand as your primary rune tree, and Sudden Impact with Treasure Hunter as your secondary tree. Use Attack Speed, Adaptive Force and Health as your shards. For items in this build, you want to complete Blade of The Ruined King as your first item, then finish Berserker's Greaves as your second item, and Guinsoo's Rageblade as third item. The last 3 options are Terminus, Jak'Sho, The Protean and Wit's End. The ability order for this build is E - Q - W. As of the current patch, this build has a 40.0% win rate over 135 matches played. Situational Kalista Runes and Items Depending on the context of your game, your matchup, and enemy champions, you might want to consider building some situational items or take specific runes. Carefully examine your team, enemy team, game state , and your matchup to plan your Kalista build accordingly! For example, when it comes to rune shards, you might want to take either Armor or Magic Resist, depending on which champion you are about to lane against. Furthermore, if you want a more detailed breakdown, you should also check out Kalista runes page.
